name: Pong (Rev E)
status: Component complement complete and verified against Atari assembly drawing A001433 Rev E — all 66 ICs at their board grid positions plus 34 discretes. The +5V and GND rails are wired and verified against each device's datasheet, including the three that break the usual TTL convention (7490/7493 on 5/10, 7483 on 5/12, 555 on 8/1). Signal nets are traced by hand from schematic 002826 Rev E and currently cover the video output chain only — 8 nets: VBLANK, 4V, NET, HVID, VVID, VIDEO and the two intermediate sums. The rest of the sheet is not yet traced, so net highlighting is partial.
